scope: Production identity/specification only; runtime oracle IDs, stats, cards and replay format remain unchanged.
decision_authority: Current owner task explicitly delegates selection of 16 launch + 4 reserve; this supersedes the earlier plan requesting a separate roster-selection approval. Source-unsupported visual details remain proposal; rights clearance is not delegated or inferred.
selection_policy: Constraint-first editorial decision: cover all 12 branches; retain both Healing, both Rage and both Toxin candidates; retain distinct caster/defender/duelist/striker/DoT/execute roles; then reduce duplicate weapons and silhouettes with small rig families. Scores support this decision, not a measured quality or balance ranking.

scoring_rubric.scale: 0 absent/unverified, 1 weak/high cost, 2 limited, 3 adequate, 4 strong, 5 distinctive/low cost. All columns higher is favorable. Ordinal editorial estimates, not measured runtime evidence.
